references.text: The Lord sends quails from the sea that cover the camp, a parallel account of the quail miracle in the wilderness
The psalm describes how God sent an east wind and a south wind and let birds rain down over the camp like dust
A poetic retelling of how the people prayed and God sent quails and satisfied them with bread from heaven
Describes how the dew fell over the camp at night, parallel to the dew that surrounded the camp in the morning
The continuation of the account explaining that the layer of dew left behind the manna when it evaporated
Describes the same event (the arrival of the quails) as an expanded retelling of Exodus 16:13.
Expands on the action from Exodus 16:13 by describing the people gathering the quails.
